Full report: https://github.com/bgrady-method/triage-bot/blob/alerting-system-grafana/stability-reviews/2026-07/2026-07-07-report.md

*Executive Summary*
- 1,820 in-window incident-log lines. No P0 in this window (2026-06-04 P0 has aged out). No confirmed outage; estimated >=99.9% on the pure-uptime axis.
- Dominant risk is NOT downtime -- it's a real error-volume surge concentrated in two chronic clusters:
  - rest-api errors: 29,410/30d vs true prior-30d baseline 2,613 -> +1,025.7%. Overlaps the chronic gateway/Ocelot-timeout cluster (532 lifetime occurrences, chronic-residual since the 2026-06-05 rollback).

- Positive trends: ms-account-api errors -53.8%; signin has plateaued (+6.7%, not still surging as the 07-02 report's thinner baseline suggested); Slack MCP restored.
- Top 5 recommendations (by ICE): (1) Re-authenticate Atlassian MCP -- ICE 48.0. (2) Widen/relativize the 5 new team:crm AMQP monitor thresholds -- ICE 22.5. (3) Instrument approutine-subscriber + ms-identity-api (silent burners, ms-identity-api ~94% health-check log spam) -- ICE 21.3. (4) File the oauth_token Jira (still unfiled, 5th report) -- ICE 18.7. (5) Monitor the Redis-circuit-breaker cascade across tables-fields/runtime-core-api -- ICE 16.3.
- PIR sync: +0 entries (Atlassian MCP unavailable, 2nd consecutive report). Jira cross-reference unavailable this cycle.
